title: Visual Rhythm
description: A workshop and presentation I conducted at my former workplace exploring visual rhythm as a graphic design principle. Using examples from music, repetition, spacing, pattern, and tempo, the session examined how rhythm can shape hierarchy, movement, and pacing within a composition.

sections.title: Rhythm in Art
sections.body: Several artworks were used as visual references to explain how rhythm can appear through repetition, spacing, movement, and composition. By comparing different artistic approaches, I showed how visual rhythm can guide attention and create structure even outside of graphic design.
